observations: Photo 0: Silver double-cab pickup, front view, Toyota logo on grille, third-generation Tacoma-style front fascia (pre-2024 facelift design), parked on gravel lot among other used cars.
Photo 1: Same truck, front-three-quarter view, visible after-market looking dark alloy wheels, running boards, no TRD badge visible on fender or door.
Photo 2: Rear view of same truck, tailgate reads a model badge and 'V6' badge, handwritten marker text on the rear window reads 'No Start 963'.
No interior, dashboard, engine bay, VIN plate, or document photos supplied.
No moonroof visible in any photo (roof line and rear glass show no sunroof glass or sunroof controls).

Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'TEEKAYWHEELS' overlay all three photos; these appear to be reseller/lot photos, possibly originally shot at an import auction yard (gravel lot, umbrellas, other cars in background typical of Nigerian bonded/auction yards).

claims.evidence: Photo 0/1: front grille, headlight and bumper styling match the 2016–2023 third-generation Tacoma, not the redesigned 2024 model; no VIN or registration shown to confirm year.
No TRD badge, TRD interior, or 4x4 drivetrain badge visible in any of the 3 photos; only a 'V6' badge is legible in photo 2.
No interior/dashboard photo provided to show a push-button start or key fob slot.
No interior or roof close-up photo; exterior roofline in photo 0/1 shows no visible sunroof glass.
No customs duty certificate, plate number, or paperwork photo provided.
No import sticker, foreign plate, or odometer/mileage photo shown to support this.

risks.risk: Vehicle may not start/run at all — a handwritten note visible on the rear window itself says 'No Start 963', directly contradicting any implied working condition and the 'push to start' claim.
risks.proof: A video of the seller starting the engine and letting it idle, with the handwritten note and plate visible in the same shot.

risks.risk: Model year may be misstated; body style matches an older Tacoma generation, not the 2024 redesign.
risks.proof: Clear photo of VIN plate and vehicle registration/customs papers showing year of manufacture.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the older (pre-2024) generation Tacoma, not as a 2024 model

risks.risk: TRD trim claim unsupported by any visible badge or interior trim detail.
risks.proof: Photo of TRD badge on fender/tailgate or TRD interior trim plate.

risks.risk: No interior condition, mileage, or electronics (push-start, moonroof) can be verified.
risks.proof: Interior dashboard photo showing odometer, start button, and sunroof controls.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base trim with unknown/high mileage and no moonroof

risks.risk: No customs/duty documentation shown despite 'verified duty' claim; could mean unpaid duty or false claim.
risks.proof: Photo of customs duty certificate/clearance paper matching chassis number.

risks.risk: Possible accident, flood, or frame damage not visible in these 3 staged exterior shots.
risks.proof: Undercarriage, engine bay, and full 360° exterior photos.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running, showing the handwritten 'No Start' note and the number plate in frame.
Clear photo of VIN plate and vehicle registration/import papers.
Interior photos: dashboard, odometer, push-start button, and sunroof/moonroof.
Photo of TRD badge or trim plate if truly TRD trim.
Customs duty certificate matching the VIN.
response.reason: The photos contain the seller's own handwritten note reading 'No Start' on the truck itself, directly contradicting the listing's implied working/push-to-start condition, and the body style shown does not match a 2024 model year as claimed; these direct contradictions between the photo evidence and the seller's words are signs of misrepresentation.
